workspaces.description: Ultimaker Cura is the world's most popular 3D printing software. It prepares your model for the 3D printer, enabling you to slice it with the optimal settings.
workspaces.notes: Based on the linuxserver.io image. This Workspace is configured to request a GPU for better 3D viewport performance. It also increases the shared memory size to 1GB to prevent potential crashes, which is a common requirement for linuxserver.io GUI applications.
